title: Volunteer firemen's parade marks 111th year in Washingtonville
text:
7 hours ago 📅 111th Orange County Volunteer Firemen’s Parade held in Washingtonville
The 111th Annual Orange County Volunteer Firemen’s Parade took place in Washingtonville on September 26 .
The parade started at 2:00 PM , despite gusty wind and occasional rain . The event began with an Escort-Guest Division , followed by five more divisions marching along the parade route.
Judges were stationed along the route to watch and score the participants. Trophies were awarded after 7:00 PM , though final results were not yet available at the time of the report.
This annual parade highlights and celebrates volunteer firefighters from across Orange County and brings the community together in Washingtonville to show support along the parade route.
